turns.question: Which ad channel had the lowest cost per lead between 17 August and 2 October 2026, and what was that cost in EUR?
turns.answer: The email channel had the lowest cost per lead, at EUR 33.57 per lead, for 17 August to 2 October 2026. Late: marketing.silver is ready only up to 2026-10-03T00:00Z, older than its 36 h deadline.
